scrubbed.method: textual substitution, CRC32-derived surrogate, distinctness preserved
scrubbed.note: Operator assignment needs UTS run data, which a local bundle does not have, so this is expected not to change inference output. Confirm with one determinism run if you rely on it.

provenance.selection: make-replay-fixture.py ranks vehicles by: destSignCode present in the bundle's csv/dsc_statistics.csv, one DSC for the whole window, distance actually travelled, and at least 30 records. Records are written in ascending (timeReceived, UUID) order.
provenance.note: Regenerating gives the unscrubbed fixture. Vehicle ranking depends on the bundle's dsc_statistics.csv, so a different bundle can select different vehicles. Run scrub-fixture.py before committing anything derived from it.
